caption:
You fought it again. Lost again? (1 Timothy 6:11)

The first charge to a “man of God” isn’t to stand and fight. It’s “flee these things.” Some temptations drag you in the longer you stand there arguing. Joseph left his cloak behind — he lost a garment and kept his purity.

Flight isn’t cowardice. It’s running toward Someone. Christ Jesus gave Himself as a ransom for all (2:6) — every step away from sin runs toward Him.
